name: 4-FPO
summary: 4'-Fluoro-4-methylaminorex (4F-MAR, 4-FPO) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with stimulant effects. It was first detected in Slovenia in 2018. It was made illegal in Italy in March 2020.

pharmacology.text: 4'-Fluoro-4-methylaminorex (4F-MAR, 4-FPO) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with stimulant effects.

uses.text: 4'-Fluoro-4-methylaminorex (4F-MAR, 4-FPO) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with stimulant effects.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of its family, the aminorex derivatives, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, anxiety and a strong urge to keep redosing. Its relative aminorex was linked to pulmonary hypertension, a serious and sometimes fatal lung condition.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的阿米雷司衍生物類興奮劑，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、焦慮，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。它的近親阿米雷司曾與肺動脈高壓有關，這是一種嚴重、有時致命的肺部疾病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的阿米雷司衍生物类兴奋剂，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、焦虑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。它的近亲阿米雷司曾与肺动脉高压有关，这是一种严重、有时致命的肺部疾病。

fact.en: It belongs to the aminorex family. Aminorex was sold as a diet pill in Europe until the late 1960s, when it was withdrawn after an outbreak of a serious lung condition, pulmonary hypertension, among people taking it.
fact.zh: 它屬於阿米雷司（aminorex）家族。阿米雷司曾在歐洲作為減肥藥販售，直到1960年代後期，因服用者中爆發嚴重的肺部疾病「肺動脈高壓」而下市。
fact.zhHans: 它属于阿米雷司（aminorex）家族。阿米雷司曾在欧洲作为减肥药贩售，直到1960年代后期，因服用者中爆发严重的肺部疾病「肺动脉高压」而下市。
